profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the insurance industry. Skilled in System Design/Development, SQL, SQR, Software Documentation, PeopleCode, and Business Intelligence. Strong information technology professional with a Bachelor of Science (BS) focused in Computer Engineering from Louisiana State University.

company.name: Blue Cross and Blue Shield of Louisiana
Blue Cross and Blue Shield of Louisiana

positions.title: Manager, Software Engineering (Corporate Applications)
positions.description: Manager of IT team supporting Workday HR, Peoplesoft Financials, and Facets Administration

positions.title: Manager, BET FI Configurations
positions.description: Responsible for managing team of seven Facets configuration analysts. Team is responsible for gathering requirements, completing analysis, design, build, unit testing, and implementation of facets benefit configuration changes related to federal regulations/mandates, state regulations/mandates and company directives.

positions.title: IT ERP Applications Architect
positions.description: Responsible for gathering requirements, designing solutions, build/unit test, defect resolution, implementation and maintenance.  Provide support needed for PeopleSoft Financials, Hyperion, ACOM3, Monthly Facets to PeopleSoft GL Extracts, Financial Audits.  Providing guidance to team members with application tools (SSIS, Informatica, PeopleCode)
